svg.title: BEEF — Bridged Engine for EME and FDTD
svg.desc: Horizontal BEEF logo with pink front lettering, a subtle radial gradient from the center, fine muscle grain and pale fat marbling; a darker crosshatched rear face tucked closely behind for a three-dimensional pop; the B, E, E, and F initials are bold in Bridged Engine for EME and FDTD. A strip steak on a grooved wooden cutting board shows three, two, and one red waveguide mode lobes, with butter, rosemary, and resting juices. All lettering, sear marks, and illustration elements are editable vectors.
